record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. The Maroc IA 2030 roadmap creates Jazari AI centres of excellence for training and applied research, not model evaluation.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. The retrieved ministry-hosted English synthesis of the July 2025 national AI conference describes the governance roadmap, ethical oversight, auditing/certification, cybersecurity and applied innovation. Its evaluation language includes programme monitoring and deployed-system safeguards, not a named institute evaluating frontier/general-purpose models for severe risks. This is useful primary governance context for the existing Maroc IA/Jazari-centre record, without proving absence or verifying every later development. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Aligned current rationale wording with the consolidated capability-or-behaviour-risk test, removing the old severity requirement. This editorial consistency pass adds no research claim and does not change status or the last full-check date.

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The ministry's English synthesis report describes governance, ethical oversight, auditing/certification, cybersecurity and applied innovation from the July 2025 national conference. The reviewed sections do not assign evaluation of advanced models for capabilities or behaviour risks to a national institute. This is primary context for the governance roadmap, not a complete verification of later Maroc IA 2030 implementation.
